{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes positive sentiment (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if true outcome is consistently lower than forecast over the last 5-10 days, indicating mean reversion or downward momentum.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast in the first 3-5 days of the 30-day window, assume model is overreacting and reduce forecast by 10-15%.",
    "If sentiment history shows negative sentiment (e.g., <0.00), increase forecast by 5-10% to account for potential bullish reversal or policy-driven support.",
    "Cap forecast at 10% above the 15-day moving average of true outcomes to prevent overshoot after sharp price spikes.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast for 3+ consecutive days, apply a downward bias correction of 5-10% to reflect structural underperformance.",
    "For sentiment history with 0.00, use a neutral correction: adjust forecast by ±2% based on 3-day moving average deviation from true outcome."
  ]
}
